# Trump's approval hits 'new low.' See latest U.S., NC approval ratings

Portrait of Iris Seaton

As August 2026 begins, another round of approval polls for President Donald Trump is available. [...] As reported by USA TODAY on Aug. 12, a recent poll from Economist/YouGov placed the president's approval ratings at a "new low," with one in three Americans, or 33%, of respondents approving of his job performance, according to the results. USA TODAY described this as the "lowest approval rating" that the president has seen in YouGov tracking since returning to office in 2025.
